setup: CREATE TABLE dependency_probe.orders(id integer PRIMARY KEY, description text, total numeric)
CREATE TABLE dependency_probe.labels(id integer PRIMARY KEY, description text)
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.direct AS SELECT o.description FROM dependency_probe.orders o JOIN dependency_probe.labels l ON o.id=l.id
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.indirect AS SELECT description FROM dependency_probe.direct
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.other_description AS SELECT l.description FROM dependency_probe.orders o JOIN dependency_probe.labels l ON o.id=l.id
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.scoped AS SELECT o.description FROM dependency_probe.orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dependency_probe.labels o WHERE o.id=1)
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.correlated AS SELECT o.description FROM dependency_probe.orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dependency_probe.labels l WHERE l.id=o.id)
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.cte_shadow AS WITH orders AS (SELECT description FROM dependency_probe.labels) SELECT description FROM orders
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.quoted_column AS SELECT "Q"."ID" FROM dependency_probe.quoted AS "Q"
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.star_columns AS SELECT q.* FROM dependency_probe.quoted q
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.count_rows AS SELECT count(*) FROM dependency_probe.orders
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.sort_alias AS SELECT 1 AS description FROM dependency_probe.orders ORDER BY description
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.group_input AS SELECT 1 AS description FROM dependency_probe.orders GROUP BY description
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.using_columns AS SELECT 1 AS result FROM dependency_probe.orders o JOIN dependency_probe.labels l USING(id)
CREATE VIEW dependency_probe.natural_columns AS SELECT 1 AS result FROM dependency_probe.orders o NATURAL JOIN dependency_probe.labels l
query: SELECT v.relname,ref.relname,d.refobjsubid,a.attname,d.deptype FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_rewrite r ON r.oid=d.objid AND d.classid='pg_rewrite'::regclass JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid=r.ev_class JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=v.relnamespace JOIN pg_class ref ON ref.oid=d.refobjid AND d.refclassid='pg_class'::regclass LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=ref.oid AND a.attnum=d.refobjsubid WHERE n.nspname='dependency_probe' ORDER BY v.relname,ref.relname,d.refobjsubid,d.deptype
